messages:
anya: Quick check — Monarch Health private/VPC onboarding. Need status on network peering, firewall rules, KMS key, and audit log sink. Anything blocking go-live?
liam: Peering is done (aws acct 111122223333, vpc-monarch-prod -> redwood-vpc). Still waiting on their firewall rule to allow outbound to our egress CIDR 52.10.0.0/20.
dionne: Monarch's security team said they'll approve the FW change today, but asked for the exact CIDR and port list. I sent them `10.50.0.0/16` + ports 443, 1025-65535 for NATed egress.
sam: I can run the smoke test once KMS is active. @liam can you drop the KMS ARN + IAM role mapping we expect?
liam: KMS ARN: `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789`. IAM role is `redwood-priv-deploy-role`. Trust relationship:```{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/redwood-connector"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}```
infra-bot: deploy-checker: network reachability OK from our edge -> returns 200 to health probe, cert not validated for HEC yet.
audit-svc: Audit forwarder planned to Splunk HEC at 10.50.1.12:8088. Monarch needs to provide TLS cert and HEC token. Also confirm log format (JSON line) and retention window.
anya: Note on account health / renewal: Monarch asked about a 6‑month committed capacity discount if we meet 200 rps baseline. Flagging renewal risk if perf or stability issues persist during ramp.
dionne: Action items (I'll track): 1) FW rule confirmation by EOD 2026-03-24; 2) KMS key policy + rotation doc approved; 3) Splunk HEC TLS cert & token; 4) smoke test + perf capture.
sam: I added a quick smoke script to the shared folder: `scripts/monarch_smoke.sh` — it validates token passthrough, basic generate, and KMS envelope unwrap. Will run after infra sign-off.
liam: Dropping the minimal IAM policy we give to their ops for reference:```{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:CreateLogStream","logs:PutLogEvents"],"Resource":"arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:111122223333:log-group:monarch-redwood-*"}
  ]
}```
anya: Monarch ops also gave feedback: they saw latency spikes tied to small cache sizes; requested an auto-fallback policy during cold starts. Can we capture that for runtime team?
sam: Yep — I'll add a short perf note and sample traces to the onboarding ticket and loop in eng-runtime.
dionne: I'm scheduling an enablement call Wed 11am PT to walk their SREs through KMS rotation, audit replay, and troubleshooting. @liam can you bring perf logs?
liam: Got it — will prepare a 10‑minute perf sample and the KV cache hit rates.
anya: :thumbsup: I'll mark account health as "watch" and add renewal owner + risk notes in CRM.
infra-bot: scheduled smoke test: 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z (will post results back here).
anya: Summary posted to Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MONARCH-ONBOARD — please add evidence links (FW approval, KMS policy, HEC cert) when ready.
